label: B · 左侧竖向书脊 + 四列密卡（无右栏）
prompt:
Design a full-bleed web page for a Chinese university second-hand marketplace, rendered edge to edge at 1536×1024, no browser window, no address bar, no device frame, no desk. Show the page itself, never a screenshot of a browser.

VISITOR'S JOB: a student scanning many items quickly, comparing prices across categories, and clicking one item to message its seller.

This composition varies the density and topology of the same design language: the classification field moves from a horizontal band to a vertical spine rail, the grid becomes denser, and the recommendation reason stops being a pull-out and becomes a printed annotation line inside the card.

STRUCTURE, named in order with scale relationships:
1. Top bar, full width, 64px tall: product name「校园二手交易平台」at left, semibold 18px; navigation at 14px (首页 / 发布 / 我的商品 / 消息 / 订单 / 个人中心); search input 260px and an unread-count badge at right. Hairline rule #C9CCC4 under the bar.
2. Left spine rail, 88px wide, running the full height below the top bar: eight stacked spines, each about 96px tall, built as a light tint field with a 4px solid saturated bar down its left edge and the Chinese category label rotated 90° reading vertically (教材书籍 / 数码电子 / 生活用品 / 运动户外 / 服饰鞋包 / 美妆护肤 / 乐器文具 / 其他闲置), each with its count in monospace at the spine's foot. This rail replaces the horizontal band and is the page's dominant colour field.
3. Main area, four equal columns of catalogue cards, 20px gutters, occupying the rest of the width; a denser, smaller card than a marketplace default so that eight cards are fully visible in the first viewport.
4. No right rail. A single thin directory-statistics line sits directly under the top bar, left aligned: 「目录里 13 张卡 · 5 类 · 今日新增 2」in 13px muted monospace.

CARD anatomy, compact: 16:10 thumbnail at top (plain flat product photograph on pale grey seamless ground); a monospace catalogue code at 11px under it, e.g.「TP311.5/12」; title in 14px, one line with ellipsis; price as the largest element at 20px semibold ink with ¥ before and 元 after; a single 12px metadata line combining seller, credit score and campus; a flat status label at bottom-left (在售 outlined / 交易中 half-filled / 已售出 filled with strike-through); and, on two cards only, a printed annotation line directly under the image in 12px muted ink reading 「因为你收藏过《数据结构》」 or 「同校区 · 一食堂门口」, separated from the code above it by a hairline rule.

PALETTE, exact: ground #F5F6F3; card surface #FFFFFF; subtle fill #E9EBE5; hairline rules #C9CCC4 at 0.5px; ink #1A1D19; muted #5C6159; the eight classification bars #7A5A2E, #1F5A6B, #35603F, #6B6A2E, #7A4260, #8C3B5A, #3A4A7A, #5A5F58 over their light tints #F1EAE0, #E4EEF0, #E6EFE8, #EFF0DF, #F2E7EC, #F5E6EB, #E7EAF3, #ECEEEA. Status: 在售 #1A1D19 outline; 交易中 #7A5A2E half-fill; 已售出 #8A8F86 fill with strike-through.

TYPE: workhorse Chinese UI sans (PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei character), regular and semibold only; monospace (Consolas character) for codes, counts and table digits. No serif.

MATERIAL AND MOOD: library shelf labels and spine labels — flat ink on paper, hairline rules, vertical coloured spines, monospace shelf codes. Calm and orderly at higher density than the card-catalogue composition.

EXCLUDE: warm cream or beige backgrounds; serif lettering; terracotta, brick or signal-red accents; gradients; glassmorphism; large soft drop shadows; pill buttons; mascots or illustrations; paper-grain texture photographs; browser chrome; English interface labels; invented logos, ratings or statistics.

The page must read as a working product screen: body text near 14px, eight fully visible cards, the vertical spine rail legible, and the whole first viewport carrying navigation, the rail, and the statistics line.
